subjects.description: A pedestrian wearing a full-body inflatable green dinosaur costume, resembling a T-Rex with a rounded belly, small dangling arms, a tail, and a large open-mouthed head with white teeth

subjects.relationship: The pedestrian the ego vehicle is yielding to at the crosswalk
subjects.location: right foreground, at the curb beside the crosswalk
subjects.orientation: Facing toward the road and the camera, angled to step onto the crosswalk
subjects.pose: Standing upright at the curb edge, leaning slightly forward as if about to step off
subjects.action: Waiting at the curb, about to cross

background_setting: A quiet urban city street on a clear, sunny day. The road is a two-lane paved street with a freshly painted white zebra crosswalk stretching across it just ahead of the vehicle. Sidewalks flank both sides, lined with low commercial buildings, a few storefronts, street lamps, and a scattering of parked cars along the curb. Trees in leaf cast dappled shade on the pavement. There is no oncoming or crossing traffic; the scene is calm and orderly with a distant intersection and traffic signage visible further down the road.

aesthetics.patterns: Repeating parallel white stripes of the zebra crosswalk

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the city street toward the marked zebra crosswalk, spotting the green dinosaur-costumed pedestrian at the right curb.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop before the crosswalk and remains fully stationary, holding position to let the pedestrian cross; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
